review_candidates.description: If you are looking for a meaningful career where people work and act with passion, rethink the existing and always strive to find the best solution - you have come to the right place. We develop future technologies to relentlessly make supply chains better. We are a leader in supply chain software solutions, helping organizations streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency. Senior Software Engineer — Integrations Remote | Mexico or Brazil Position Overview We are looking for a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer to join our Integrations team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain integration solutions that connect our K.Motion Warehouse Edge platform with Enterprise Resource Planning systems, carrier services, and trading partners. You will work in a fast-paced Agile environment, collaborating closely with developers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality, reliable integration software. Key Responsibilities Software Development Excellence Design, develop, and maintain integration services connecting WMS to ERP systems, carriers, and trading partners Develop a thorough understanding of the product architecture and integration patterns within 6 months Independently, and with your squad, design and develop feature enhancements and resolve bugs Ensure that products developed are of high quality and completed on time Deliver in line with project committed metrics on Velocity, Quality, and Accuracy of Estimates Technical Direction Serve as the guardian for your squad's code, processes, and best practices Identify gaps and propose enhancements in the integration architecture Identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement in integration approaches Stay up to date on new technologies and development practices Process Improvement Constantly improve methods of product development to increase productivity and quality Share ideas for process, workflow, and continuous improvement initiatives Understand and follow all team processes while actively suggesting improvements Collaboration & Communication Mentor more junior developers in processes, technologies, products, design patterns, and coding styles Collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders across the organization Communicate clearly to understand requirements and align solutions with organizational goals Produce high-quality technical documentation, code demos, and concise written communications Participate in the Agile process Qualifications Required 5+ years of experience in C# .NET development Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or related field 2+ years of experience in an Agile development environment Proven track record of delivering high-quality, commercial software Experience mentoring or guiding more junior team members Demonstrated ability to articulate major technical problems and corresponding solutions Preferred 3+ years of experience in Logistics, Supply Chain, Warehouse Management, or ERP integration domains Experience in integration/middleware development connecting enterprise systems Required TECHNICAL SKILLS C# and .NET Framework 4.8 — strong working knowledge JavaScript — strong working knowledge OData/REST APIs including Swagger/OpenAPI — proficiency in creating and consuming WCF (Windows Communication Foundation) — service development and consumption MSSQL — T-SQL, stored procedures, complex queries NHibernate ORM — mappings, session management, criteria API EDI document processing (850, 856, 810, 753) JSON/XML data transformation and mapping Debugging and troubleshooting distributed systems Azure DevOps, Git version control, branching, and pull request workflows Preferred Enterprise Resource Planning systems and their APIs (SAP Business One, D365 Business Central, Oracle NetSuite, Sage 300, Acumatica) Warehouse Management System business processes (receiving, picking, shipping, inventory) AWS API Gateway and Lambda Message queues / event-driven architecture (Service Bus, SQS, RabbitMQ) OAuth 2.0 / API key authentication patterns Multi-tenant SaaS architectures Carrier shipping APIs (UPS, FedEx, DHL) Spring.NET or IoC/DI container experience CI/CD pipeline automation Cloud/SaaS environments Reading and maintaining legacy code (xbase++, VB, or similar) Postman / API testing tools proficiency Use of AI prompts for development assistance COMPETENCIES Successful Candidates Will Demonstrate Strength In The Following Areas: Communication — clear, concise oral and written communication skills Collaboration — works effectively across teams and functions Strategic Thinking — connects day-to-day work to broader organizational goals Innovation — embraces new ideas and drives creative problem-solving Commitment — delivers on promises and takes ownership of outcomes Adaptability and Flexibility — thrives in a dynamic, fast-changing environment Time Management and Prioritization — manages workload effectively across competing priorities Integrity — acts with honesty and transparency Growth Mindset — continuously seeks opportunities to learn and improve PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS In your first year, success will be measured by your ability to: Develop a thorough understanding of the integration architecture and connected systems Deliver consistently against project velocity, quality, and estimation accuracy targets Independently design and deliver integration features connecting WMS to ERP/carrier systems Proactively identify and resolve gaps in integration reliability and error handling Mentor junior team members and contribute to team standards and best practices Produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with stakeholders Why join us? At Infios, we're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners in innovation, growth, and purpose. Meeting you where you are to create the future you need is at the core of who we are and what we do. review_candidates.title: Senior Cloud Software Developer
review_candidates.description: Date: Sep 12, 2026 Location: AUSTIN, TX, US, 78751 Join the Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) and be part of a team committed to creating a positive impact in the lives of fellow Texans. At HHSC, your contributions matter, and we support you at each stage of your life and work journey. Our comprehensive benefits package includes 100% paid employee health insurance for full-time eligible employees, a defined benefit pension plan, generous time off benefits, numerous opportunities for career advancement and more. Explore more details on the Benefits of Working at HHS webpage. Functional Title: Senior Cloud Software Developer Job Title: Programmer IV Agency: Health & Human Services Comm Department: Public Hlth Services Appl-425 Posting Number: 20158 Closing Date: 09/27/2026 Posting Audience: Internal and External Occupational Category: Computer and Mathematical Salary Range: $6,377.50 - $8,581.66 Pay Frequency: Monthly Salary Group: TEXAS-B-26 Shift: Day Additional Shift: Days (First) Telework Travel: Regular/Temporary: Regular Full Time/Part Time: Full time FLSA Exempt/Non-Exempt: Exempt Facility Location: Job Location City: AUSTIN Job Location Address: 701 W 51ST ST Other Locations: MOS Codes: 0673,2652,8846,8848,16KX,181X,182X,255A,255S,25B,26B,62E,681X,682X,781X,782X,8K000,CT,CTR,CWT,CYB10 CYB11,ISM,IT,Z Prefix Brief Job Description This position is open to U.S. Citizens and permanent residents. This onsite role requires the selected candidate to work from an HHS office in Austin, Texas. Works under the general supervision of the Public Health Application Product Delivery and Support Manager. Performs highly advanced, senior-level analysis and leads the development of system solutions that support complex business processes. Serves as a key customer interface for application-related activities and support, and oversees the work of functional analysts and programmers. Attends work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with agency leave policy and performs other duties as assigned. Performs highly advanced, senior-level analysis, design, development, deployment, and support of enterprise applications, with emphasis on cloud-based solutions, application modernization, system integration, automation, and secure software delivery. Work involves planning, analyzing, architecting, designing, and developing user requirements, test plans and scripts, procedures, utility programs, charts, diagrams, tables, flowcharts, and related documentation. Responsibilities include troubleshooting and resolving issues, triaging tickets, developing code, testing and deploying solutions, and monitoring and maintaining servers. Effectively develops and communicates technical and system requirements, including SDLC-related information, to staff responsible for acquiring, developing, and implementing products and services. Interacts with customers to understand business needs and communicates technical solutions in terms customers can understand. Participates effectively in cross-functional teams. Work is performed under general supervision with moderate latitude for initiative and independent judgment. May train others. This position is classified as a full-time position (40 hours a week). Work outside of regular hours may be required. Travel to other work locations may be required. Performs other duties as assigned. Essential Job Functions (EJFs) Oversees and develops enterprise applications, including system design, architecture, planning, production implementation, integration, and customer support for software systems and solutions, as well as existing production applications and new applications used statewide and across agencies. Drives the design, development, delivery, modernization, and integration of interfaces, system connectivity, and batch processes for new and existing applications. (40%) Coordinates daily development activities, including coding, testing, and debugging programs that are in development or require support for issue resolution, performance improvements, or enhancements. Implements standards and procedures while coordinating the activities of programming staff. Coordinates staff, tasks, and schedules to develop, modify, and maintain customer software applications. Ensures development activities follow applicable security, accessibility, coding, testing, change management, and deployment standards. (20%) Provides technical direction and guidance to technical staff on matters related to analysis and programming activities. Supports the development of business processes through analysis and design for interfaces with various external agencies and service providers. Implements specialized programs to support applications and defines testing processes to validate performance and stability. (20%) Coordinates with staff, customers, and technical teams to develop and implement project plans, including schedules, staff assignments, analysis tasks, requirements gathering, gap analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and final delivery. Assists and coordinates with development staff to ensure adherence to agency standards, procedures, business policies, and implementing practices. (10%) Other duties as assigned. (Note: For DSHS positions this includes but is not limited to actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role to meet the agency’s obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation. Such participation may require an alternate shift pattern assignment and/or location.) (10%) Knowledge, Skills And Abilities (KSAs) Technical Knowledge Knowledge of computer programming, systems analysis, computer operations, and programming languages. Knowledge of IT service delivery methods for large enterprise environments. Knowledge of SDLC phases, including scope, proposal, analysis, design, construction, testing, deployment, and support. Knowledge of software architecture, system integration, databases, interfaces, cloud computing, and distributed application environments. Technical Skills Skilled in problem-solving, critical thinking, software development, and the effective use of computer hardware and software to design, develop, modify, and support enterprise applications. Extensive experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting mission-critical applications operating in highly distributed and scalable environments. Skilled in Agile methodologies, frameworks, tools, and best practices for software development and delivery. Strong documentation skills, including the development and maintenance of workflows, data flow diagrams, technical specifications, design documents, user guides, and operational procedures. Skilled in front-end and back-end software development using languages and tools such as Java, Microsoft .NET, C#, SQL, and PL/SQL. Skilled in cloud computing, server administration, monitoring, and management, preferably Azure. Skilled in CI/CD pipelines, deployments, automation tools, scripting, and operational monitoring. Skilled in identifying security vulnerabilities and implementing security controls. Leadership and Communication Skilled in leading development staff, providing technical direction, mentoring team members, and coordinating work activities. Skilled in active listening and effective verbal and written communication with technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to facilitate meetings, build consensus, mediate compromises, and maintain effective working relationships. Ability to manage multiple tasks, schedules, deliverables, and priorities in a team environment. Ability to communicate ideas, recommendations, and technical concepts clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing, to diverse audiences and stakeholder groups Registrations, Licensure Requirements Or Certifications None Initial Screening Criteria Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with major coursework in computer science, information systems, software engineering, or a related field is preferred. Must have at least five years of experience in software development, including experience with multiple programming languages, relational databases, SQL, application integration, and cloud-based application development or support. Experience with Java, Microsoft .NET, C#, SQL/PLSQL, Azure, CI/CD pipelines, automation tools, and enterprise application support is preferred. Additional Information Any employment offer is contingent upon available budgeted funds. The offered salary will be determined in accordance with budgetary limits and the requirements of HHSC Human Resources Manual. Selected candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. Selected candidate must be willing to commute to the office on the required days. Review our Tips for Success when applying for jobs at DFPS, DSHS and HHSC. Active Duty, Military, Reservists, Guardsmen, And Veterans Military occupation(s) that relate to the initial selection criteria and registration or licensure requirements for this position may include, but not limited to those listed in this posting. All active-duty military, reservists, guardsmen, and veterans are encouraged to apply if qualified to fill this position. For more information please see the Texas State Auditor’s Job Descriptions, Military Crosswalk and Military Crosswalk Guide at Texas State Auditor's Office - Job Descriptions. ADA Accommodations In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), HHSC and DSHS agencies will provide reasonable accommodation during the hiring and selection process for qualified individuals with a disability. If you need assistance completing the on-line application, contact the HHS Employee Service Center at 1-888-894-4747. If you are contacted for an interview and need accommodation to participate in the interview process, please notify the person scheduling the interview. Pre-Employment Checks And Work Eligibility Depending on the program area and position requirements, applicants selected for hire may be required to pass background and other due diligence checks. HHSC uses E-Verify. You must bring your I-9 documentation with you on your first day of work. Download the I-9 Form Telework Disclaimer This position may be eligible for telework. Please note, all HHS positions are subject to state and agency telework policies in addition to the discretion of the direct supervisor and business needs. Nearest Major Market: Austin

review_candidates.location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
review_candidates.description: Description This is a senior level Full Stack Developer role, with a 30% BE / 70% FE split, working within a talented team providing the best-in-class, custom cinema websites worldwide. Using your extensive experience with React.js, TypeScript, .Net, CSS/SCSS, REST APIs, you will own features and projects, collaborating with wider stakeholders such as Product Owners, Business Analysts, and Engineering Managers, with a focus on continuous improvement. Experienced with modern Agile software development, you will advocate team quality and productivity through peer programming, code reviews, and of course your own development, producing a code base that is high quality, maintainable and always maturing. Key Responsibilities Develop server-side applications, user interfaces and user experiences working with React, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, .Net, SCSS/CSS Deliver new, and maintain existing features within Umbraco backed CMS Develop and integrate RESTAPIs Implement responsive web design to ensure optimal user experience across various devices and screen sizes Ensure cross-browser compatibility and address performance issues Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms to secure web applications Optimize server-side performance and troubleshoot issues Use version control systems like Git to manage and track changes in code Collaborate with team members on code repositories, resolving conflicts and ensuring code quality Deploy web applications to hosting platforms or servers Configure and maintain web servers, ensuring optimal performance and security. Implement continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for automated testing and deployment Write and maintain automated tests to ensure code quality Debug and troubleshoot issues across the entire application stack Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, product managers, and other developers Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, providing updates on progress and addressing concerns Join the on-call support roster during holiday periods Requirements Proven, senior level, full stack web development experience in a commercial / ecommerce organisation, with a stronger focus on front-end development (React/TypeScript) Advanced level React (Hooks, Context, APIs etc...) Strong TypeScript, JavaScript experience Strong C#, .Net experience (web APIs, MVC) Experience with CSS/SCSS, Tailwind or similar frameworks Extensive web development experience including SPA, SEO, cross-browser, REST APIs design / integration, SASS / LESS Solid experience with Git (GitHub/GitLab workflows, CI/CD pipelines, Agile SDLC) Experience collaborating with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and Engineering Managers Previous exposure to Umbraco CMS would be beneficial Previous experience with Docker would be beneficial Experience acting as a team lead, including mentoring developers and owning delivery for features / projects, would be beneficial This is a hybrid role with a home and office-based split, requiring regular weekly (2 days per week) attendance in the Cape Town office. We are only considering applicants with an existing right to work in South Africa, without the need for employer sponsorship. About Vista Vista Group is the global leader in providing technology solutions to the international film industry. With brands including Vista, Veezi, Movio, Numero, Maccs, Flicks and Powster, our expertise covers cinema management software; loyalty, moviegoer engagement and marketing; film distribution software; box office reporting; creative studio solutions; and movie, cinema and streaming content discovery. With more than 700 crew based across six main offices, in New Zealand (Auckland headquarters), the USA, the UK, South Africa, the Netherlands, and Mexico, our people are our most important asset. Across the group brands our teams provide market-leading services to clients in more than 100 countries. We are proud of our diversity and have placed a high priority on being an inclusive workplace that is reflective of our clients and communities. It is important to us to foster an environment that empowers people to realise their full potential. We aim to do ‘good things with good people’ and we’re proud to say that more than two decades on that’s exactly what we do every single day. Shared Standards Our Shared Standards act as a compass for how we work together and reflect the behaviours we value at Vista Group. The way in which each member of our crew embodies these Shared Standards is an indicator for performance and success, as it aligns with our vision and strategy. One Crew We're a diverse team, in different places and functions, and we're at our best when we connect, help and collaborate Shine a Light We communicate openly, we explain the why, and we ask when we don't understand. We don't leave people in the dark Make it Happen We make good things happen as people and as teams through our focus on delivery Chase Great We challenge ourselves and each other to keep improving Benefits You will be supported to continually learn and improve your skills, share knowledge and ideas in the team, and be part of a dynamic and open culture. We have a range of benefits that include: Rest & Relax Fridays - Finish at lunch time on Friday but get paid for the full day Annual volunteer day Defined Contribution Company Pension Scheme Medical Insurance / Medical Aid (after qualifying period) Employee Assistance Programme Service Paid Sick leave 5 days bereavement leave per year On-Site Breakfast Bar If this sounds like you, get in touch to find out more We value inclusivity celebrate diversity and are committed to offering equal opportunity to our staff and candidates — regardless of gender, age, race, ethnicity, marital status, disability, sex, sexual orientation, religious, ethical beliefs or political opinion. This commitment is reflected in all our employment policies and procedures.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer based in Germany. This is a senior backend engineering role focused on building the data infrastructure behind a large-scale enterprise process platform. You will design and evolve storage, query, and data-processing capabilities across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. Your work will directly influence how process data is stored, retained, queried, monitored, and exposed to customers. You will own substantial engineering initiatives from solution design through delivery, working closely with Product, QA, Support, and SRE. The environment is highly distributed and remote-first, with a strong emphasis on technical ownership, collaboration, and production excellence. You will also contribute to challenging problems around performance, scalability, data pipelines, and reliable operation at scale. The role offers the opportunity to shape a critical data layer while contributing to an increasingly AI-driven enterprise software platform. Accountabilities Design, build, maintain, and improve backend services responsible for storing and serving process data at enterprise scale. Develop solutions across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, balancing correctness, performance, availability, scalability, and maintainability. Own engineering initiatives from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, coordination, delivery, and production rollout. Partner closely with Product Management and cross-functional engineering teams to translate business and customer requirements into actionable technical solutions. Evolve data processing, retention, storage, and exposure capabilities to meet changing customer and product requirements. Improve the performance and scalability of secondary storage systems as usage and data volumes grow. Build internal tooling and operational capabilities that make the data layer easier to understand, troubleshoot, monitor, and operate safely in production. Investigate production data issues, including slow queries, execution plans, indexing problems, and other performance bottlenecks, and drive them through root-cause analysis and resolution. Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, collaborating with Support and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve production incidents. Use production learnings and operational insights to continuously improve the reliability, performance, and usability of the data layer. Provide and receive clear, constructive feedback through code reviews and technical collaboration. Contribute to the evolution of engineering practices and architecture within a remote-first, cross-functional environment. Requirements 7+ years of professional experience as a backend software engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores. Deep hands-on experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, or MSSQL. Strong practical experience with Elasticsearch and/or OpenSearch, including indexing, query performance, and data modeling trade-offs. Proven ability to investigate slow queries, analyze execution plans and index usage, and identify root causes of production data and performance issues. Demonstrated experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives lasting three months or longer, covering solution design, planning, cross-team coordination, and predictable delivery. Strong understanding of backend architecture, data storage, query systems, and production-scale engineering. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly in a distributed and remote-first environment. Ability to translate product requirements into clear technical plans and actionable engineering work. Comfortable working independently while maintaining strong alignment with Product, Engineering, Support, and SRE stakeholders. Willingness and ability to use the product directly to understand customer workflows and technical requirements. Experience with workflow automation or process orchestration software is a plus. Experience working across both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch is advantageous. Experience building or maintaining CI pipelines is beneficial. Familiarity with database migration tools such as Liquibase or Flyway and with schema evolution in live production systems is a plus. Benefits Fully remote position with flexibility to work from anywhere within the eligible EMEA region. Competitive, location-based compensation designed around local market conditions. Equity opportunities through a Virtual Stock Option Plan where applicable. Home office budget and support for coworking spaces. Flexible time off to support sustainable work and wellbeing. Locally tailored healthcare benefits where applicable. Access to global mental wellbeing support. Flexible lifestyle spending benefits covering areas such as fitness, family care, personal interests, experiences, and financial wellbeing. Retirement and pension plans, often including company contributions, depending on location. Life and disability insurance where applicable. Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-directed professional development, including courses, certifications, and books. Opportunities to connect with colleagues through annual company kickoffs, team offsites, local gatherings, and connection budgets. Inclusive, remote-first working environment with strong emphasis on collaboration, autonomy, and professional growth.
